title: The Capsule is read-only and the source is never mutated
method: the Capsule builder and the delivery provider are pure reads; the attributed Preview reads through the official reader; no path writes to the DSH session source or to canonical Work
observed: buildTrajectoryContextCapsuleChecked reads no owner and writes nothing; the delivery provider calls capsuleForConsumer (a read) and returns a frozen projection; no Session artifact or Work event is appended by any P2-D1 read path
expectedInvariant: delivering history changes no authority-bearing state
